[[Liam Dowling]] (5–3) | previous = [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship 1951|1951]] | next = [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship 1953|1953]] }} The '''1952 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship''' was the 66th staging of the All-Ireland [[hurling]] championship since its establishment by the [[Gaelic Athletic Association]] in 1887. The championship began on 27 April 1952 and ended on 7 September 1952. [[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]] were the [[1951 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship|defending champions]] and were on course for a record-equalling fourth successive All-Ireland, however, they were defeated in the provincial championship. [[Cork GAA|Cork]] won the title following a 2–14 to 0–7 defeat of [[Dublin GAA|Dublin]] in the [[1952 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final|final]]. ==Teams== ===Team summaries=== {| This 16-game unbeaten streak, which included 15 wins and one draw, was a record which stood until 9 August 2009 when Kilkenny recorded their 17th successive championship victory.{{cite web|url=http://www.independent.ie/sport/gaelic-football/as-kilkenny-aim-for-a-historic-fiveinarow-the-records-show-how-hard-it-is-to-keep-winning-26677383.html|title=As Kilkenny aim for a historic five-in-a-row, the records show how hard it is to keep winning|publisher=Irish Independent|date=3 December 2012|access-date=17 April 2014}} ==Sources== * Corry, Eoghan, ''The GAA Book of Lists'' (Hodder Headline Ireland, 2005). * Donegan, Des, ''The Complete Handbook of Gaelic Games'' (DBA Publications Limited, 2005). * Horgan, Tim, ''Christy Ring: Hurling's Greatest'' (The Collins Press, 2007). * Nolan, Pat, ''Flashbacks: A Half Century of Cork Hurling'' (The Collins Press, 2000). * Sweeney, Éamonn, ''Munster Hurling Legends'' (The O'Brien Press, 2002). ==External links== * [https://web.archive.org/web/20140416081915/http://www.hurlingstats.ie/competition/code/AIHC/1952 1952 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship results] ==References== {{reflist}} {{Hurling All-Irelands}} [[Category:All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championships|1956]]
